user.title: Add RPI2DMD
user.description: A request will display a temporary code on your physical RPI2DMD screen.

pairing.title: Pair RPI2DMD
pairing.description: Enter the six digits on the DMD. If the code expired, select “Request a new code” and confirm at the next step; you can leave the code field empty.

discovery_confirm.title: RPI2DMD discovered
discovery_confirm.description: Pair {name}? Confirm to request a code on its physical display.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate RPI2DMD
reauth_confirm.description: RPI2DMD rejected authentication. Confirm to request a code on the DMD and renew the existing pairing.

pairing_restart.title: Restart pairing
pairing_restart.description: Request a code from {name}? An active code will be reused. Do not repeat requests while rate limited.

error.invalid_auth: Final authentication failed. Generate a new code.
error.pairing_inactive: Code expired or pairing inactive. Request a new code.
error.invalid_pairing_code: Invalid or expired code. Retry after one second, or generate a new code.
error.pairing_timeout: Connection timed out. Check RPI2DMD and generate a new code if needed.
error.pairing_rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait one minute (up to fifteen minutes after three requests).
error.pairing_unavailable: Pairing display unavailable. Check that RPI2DMD is running.
error.pairing_expired: The code expired. Request a new code.
error.invalid_device: The response does not identify a compatible RPI2DMD.

abort.invalid_device: The response does not identify a compatible RPI2DMD.
abort.pairing_timeout: Connection timed out. Check RPI2DMD and generate a new code if needed.
abort.invalid_auth: Final authentication failed. Generate a new code.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This device is not the expected RPI2DMD.
abort.already_in_progress: Pairing for this RPI2DMD is already in progress.
